newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Abu Qir post-tax profit up in 95/6.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Abu Qir post-tax profit up in 95/6.

text.p: Egypt's Abu Qir Fertiliser and Chemical Industries after-tax profits rose to 196.61 million pounds ($57.64 million) in the financial year 1995/96 from 164.98 million pounds in 1995/94, the company balance sheet published on Wednesday in Al-Ahram official newspaper showed.
The financial year ended on June 30.
The partly private company said it would distribute a 4.07 pound dividend for each of its 37,767,240 shares. Dividends for 1994/95 were lower at 4.02 pounds.
Net sales were also higher at 560.269 million from 547.348 million in 1994/95.
Abu Qir shares closed at 56.99 pounds on Tuesday.
Total shareholders' equity was 681.566 million pounds in 1995/96, up from 651.73 million pounds in the previous year.
